Introduction

DaHyun is a South Korean singer under MODHAUS.

DaHyun was introduced as the tenth member of the girl group tripleS under MODHAUS on December 3, 2022. She made her debut with the first ten members of the group on February 13, 2023, with the mini album "ASSEMBLE".

As a member of tripleS, DaHyun was placed in the sub-units LOVElution, Aria, and Neptune.
